admin.title: Administration
admin.heading: Administration
admin.intro: Manage provider operations and the public presentation of the site.
admin.nav.label: Administration sections
admin.conversions.title: Conversion tracking
admin.conversions.intro: Receive server-to-server postbacks from configured providers and attribute conversions to outbound clicks or widget touchpoints when the SID is returned.
admin.conversions.endpoint_hint: Postback settings are managed in Integrations. This page shows current status, endpoints, tests and conversion results.
admin.conversions.no_supported_providers: None of the enabled providers currently supports postbacks.
admin.conversions.test_intro: Create one signed test conversion using the same validation and database path as the public endpoint.
admin.conversions.test_sid_hint: The latest Chaturbate click is prefilled. Leave empty to verify an unattributed conversion.
admin.conversions.test_sid_hint_provider: The latest {provider} SID is prefilled, including a possible widget touchpoint. Leave it empty for an unattributed test.
admin.conversions.test_not_configured: Enable the Chaturbate postback and configure its validation salt first.
admin.conversions.livejasmin_test_not_co: Enable the LiveJasmin postback and configure its required secret first.
admin.conversions.no_events: No conversion event types have been recorded yet.
admin.conversions.no_sources: No outbound clicks have been attributed to a source page yet.
admin.catalog_settings.title: Public catalog
admin.catalog_settings.intro: Choose which sources and performer types to synchronize and how they are presented to visitors.
admin.catalog_settings.boundary_text: Provider credentials and secrets are managed in Integrations and stored in config/local.php.
admin.catalog_settings.sources_intro: Enable ready providers, choose the affiliate source for each network, and limit the performer types that are imported and published.
admin.configuration.title: Integrations
admin.configuration.intro: Manage provider credentials, feeds, players, postbacks and policies. Sensitive credentials are edited here but remain stored only in config/local.php.
admin.configuration.language_hint: Every installed language pack is available automatically.
admin.configuration.providers_intro: Enable sources that do not have an alternative Direct/CrakRevenue route.
admin.configuration.provider_options_int: Configure provider-specific feed behavior. Published sources are selected in Public catalog.
admin.configuration.secrets_hint: Credential values are never displayed or stored in the database.
admin.configuration.performer_types_intr: Choose which normalized performer types the site imports and exposes across every enabled provider.
admin.configuration.performer_types_hint: Select at least one. Run a new synchronization after saving; excluded types are also blocked from catalog filters, profiles, landings, media, widgets and the sitemap.
admin.configuration.livejasmin_categorie: Feed categories use the official canonical values and are intersected with the performer types selected in Public catalog. Select at least one compatible category when LiveJasmin is enabled.
admin.configuration.bongacams_detect_ip: Automatically detect the public IP for BongaCams
admin.configuration.new_strategies_hint: Automatic uses the provider's official flag when supplied and falls back to the first local sighting only when that flag is unavailable. Provider flag may produce no results for feeds without this field; First seen can classify a returning performer as new after provider data has been deleted.
admin.configuration.allow_empty: Allow an empty provider response to complete a sync
admin.configuration.allow_empty_warning: Keep this disabled unless the provider explicitly uses empty successful feeds.
admin.configuration.block_non_public: Block rooms that are not publicly available
admin.configuration.base_url_local: The canonical base URL remains local: {url}
admin.configuration.postbacks_intro: Each provider is optional. Enable only the integrations you use; validation secrets remain local.
admin.configuration.policies_warning: Enable retention, indexing or image caching only when the provider's current terms explicitly allow it.
admin.configuration.affiliate_routes_int: Choose Disabled, Direct, or CrakRevenue for each network. Only one source can publish a network at a time.
admin.configuration.direct_media_only: The provider requires direct media URLs: proxying and caching are disabled.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_test_int: Optional diagnostic: checks the documented CrakRevenue sources with minimal requests. A source can be enabled before this test; the result only records whether the current credentials were verified.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_not_conf: Configure the CrakRevenue API key and token in Integrations first.
admin.configuration.recruitment_index: Allow search engines to index the recruitment page
admin.configuration.reset_intro: Restore technical settings from the distributed defaults without changing published providers, performer types or public-language choices.
admin.configuration.reset_confirm: Restore the technical integration settings to their distributed defaults?
admin.configuration.reset_done: Integration settings reset to file defaults.
admin.catalog_settings.combined_hint: Enable at least two sources in the section above to use the combined catalog.
admin.catalog_settings.primary_hint: Used by single-provider mode and as the fallback for legacy profile URLs.
admin.catalog_settings.show_filter: Allow visitors to filter the combined catalog by provider
admin.catalog_settings.show_badges: Show the provider name on performer cards
admin.catalog_settings.public_hint: These controls are only visible or relevant when combined mode is active.
admin.catalog_settings.offline_hint: This fallback is handled by the provider's official embedded widget.
admin.catalog_settings.sources_saved: Catalog sources and performer types saved. Run a synchronization to refresh the content.
admin.catalog_settings.error: The catalog settings could not be saved.
admin.appearance.title: Appearance
admin.appearance.intro: Customize the public identity of the site without editing source files.
admin.appearance.logo_hint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It replaces the textual name in the header.
admin.appearance.favicon_hint: PNG or ICO, up to 2 MB.
admin.appearance.footer_hint: Leave it empty to use the site name, version and environment.
admin.appearance.error: The appearance settings could not be saved. Check the entered values and image formats.
admin.appearance.reset_intro: Removes custom branding and restores the original colors and localized homepage content.
admin.appearance.reset_done: The default appearance has been restored.
admin.setup_intro: This first-time step protects synchronization and operational data. Use a non-trivial password of at least 12 characters.
admin.geo.title: Visitor location safeguards
admin.geo.detected: Current request resolved as {location} through {source}. No IP address is stored.
admin.geo.unknown: The current request could not be resolved to a country and language. Performers with geographic or language restrictions are hidden as a safeguard.
admin.sync_intro: Fetch enabled provider feeds and safely update each online catalog. Concurrent runs for the same provider are blocked.
admin.sync_batch_completed: Provider synchronization completed: {success} succeeded, {failed} failed, {count} performers imported.
admin.history_retention: The latest 20 runs are shown. Records older than {days} days are deleted automatically.
admin.no_runs: No synchronization has been recorded yet.
admin.error.csrf: The session expired. Please try again.
admin.error.setup: Use a username of at least 3 characters, matching, non-trivial passwords of at least 12 characters.
admin.error.provider: The requested provider is not enabled.
installer.title: Installation
installer.heading: First-run setup
installer.intro: Configure the site, database, administrator account and initial providers. LiveCamForge will create the database schema and apply every bundled migration before the first launch.
installer.password_hint: It is normally empty in XAMPP.
installer.affiliate_hint: You can leave it empty when using demo mode.
installer.bongacams_hint: Leave empty for automatic detection. Use a manual value only when the affiliate API requires a specific geographic reference.
installer.livejasmin_hint: Keep this key private. It is used only by server-side synchronization.
installer.crakrevenue_hint: One credential pair enables the networks approved for your account; choose individual sources later in Admin.
installer.admin_password_hint: Use at least 12 characters. A long, unique passphrase is recommended; symbols are not mandatory.
installer.error.database_name: The database name is not valid.
installer.error.config: Unable to write config/local.php. Check the folder permissions.
installer.error.admin: Use an administrator name of at least 3 characters and matching, non-trivial passwords of at least 12 characters.
installer.error.bongacams: Enter a valid BongaCams campaign ID and leave the IPv4 empty or enter a public IPv4 address.
installer.error.livejasmin: Enter a valid LiveJasmin PS ID and Model Feed access key.
installer.error.stripchat: Enter the Stripcash Bearer key and user ID to use Stripchat directly.
installer.error.crakrevenue: Enter the CrakRevenue API key and token to use this source.
admin.landings.title: Landing Manager
admin.landings.intro: Enable and edit standard discovery pages or create curated landing pages from safe catalog filters and original content.
admin.landings.select_intro: Choose a configured landing or create a custom one.
admin.landings.slug_hint: The slug becomes part of the public URL and cannot be renamed after saving.
admin.landings.index_hint: Indexable pages automatically become noindex when they fall below the minimum result count or receive extra visitor filters.
admin.landings.markdown_hint: Safe Markdown: ## headings, ### subheadings, lists, **bold**, *italic* and links. HTML, scripts and embeds are never accepted.
admin.landings.delete_confirm: Delete this custom landing? Its public URL will stop working.
admin.landings.error: The landing could not be saved: {message}
admin.appearance.preset_hint: Choose a starting theme, then customize colors and font freely. Manual changes are detected as Custom.
admin.appearance.card_style_hint: Card style is independent from the color theme and changes the public catalog.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_postback: One endpoint handles all CrakRevenue cam offers; offer and goal IDs are normalized automatically.
admin.conversions.duplicate_test_complet: Deduplication test passed: the second identical postback was detected as a duplicate.
admin.conversions.duplicate_test_first_d: Deduplication test could not start because the first generated event was already a duplicate.
admin.conversions.duplicate_test_failed: Deduplication test failed: the second identical postback was not detected as a duplicate.
admin.configuration.provider_player_mode: Choose the presentation independently for direct providers that support both modes. Stream only keeps the player visually consistent; full embed keeps the provider room/chat experience. CAM4 remains stream-only.
installer.cam4_tune_api_key: CAM4 TUNE API key (optional for conversion polling)
installer.cam4_hint: The performer feed needs only the Affiliate ID. TUNE credentials are used only to poll conversions.
installer.error.cam4: CAM4 requires a valid CAM4Pays Affiliate ID.
installer.requirements_blocked: Installation is blocked until all mandatory requirements are satisfied.
installer.error.requirements: The server does not satisfy all installation requirements.
installer.error.csrf: The installation form expired or is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
installer.error.locked: Another installation request is already running. Wait a few seconds and try again.
installer.error.database: Unable to initialize the database. Check host, port, database permissions and credentials.
installer.error.unexpected: Installation failed unexpectedly. Check the server error log and try again.
installer.base_url: Public base URL (optional during local setup)
installer.base_url_hint: Use the final HTTPS URL in production. You can leave it empty locally and set it later in Admin/configuration.
installer.providers_hint: Select one or more providers. When more than one is enabled, the initial catalog is configured in combined mode.
installer.error.providers: Select at least one initial provider.
installer.error.site: Enter a valid site name and an absolute HTTP/HTTPS base URL, or leave the base URL empty.
installer.error.timezone: Enter a valid PHP timezone identifier, for example Europe/Rome or UTC.
installer.error.chaturbate: Enter the Chaturbate affiliate code (WM) to enable Chaturbate directly.
installer.timezone_hint: Choose any IANA/PHP timezone. The list is generated by the installed PHP runtime.
installer.provider_configuration_hint: Only the providers selected above are shown. CrakRevenue credentials are shared by all enabled CrakRevenue sources.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_test_opt: Verification is optional. “Not tested” does not mean that the source is unavailable.
admin.catalog_settings.single_multiple_w: Multiple providers are enabled, but the public catalog currently shows only {provider}. Switch to Combined providers to publish them together.
admin.configuration.provider_credentials: Configure every supported direct provider and the shared CrakRevenue integration here. Public identifiers can be edited directly; stored secrets are never displayed back in the browser.
admin.configuration.local_config_not_wri: config/local.php is not writable by PHP. Provider credentials cannot be changed from Admin until file permissions are fixed.
admin.configuration.secret_leave_blank: Secret fields are write-only. Leave them blank to keep the currently stored value.
admin.configuration.bongacams_client_ip_: BongaCams may use the public IPv4 address as a geographic reference for API requests. Keep automatic detection enabled in most installations. Disable it only when your hosting requires a specific public IPv4 address, then enter that address manually.
admin.configuration.cam4_tune_hint: The performer feed needs only the Affiliate ID. TUNE credentials are optional and are used for conversion polling.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_shared_h: These credentials are shared by all CrakRevenue cam sources. Source authorization is tested separately and is not required to save the credentials.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_status_h: Not tested means no authorization check has been run yet. It does not mean the source is disabled.
admin.configuration.provider_credentials: Credentials and postback secrets are written to config/local.php, not to the database. Secret values are never rendered back into the page.
admin.configuration.stripchat_autoplay_h: The default is Autoplay stream, matching the intended Stripchat embedded-player behaviour.
admin.configuration.provider_player_mode: Choose how this provider is displayed on performer pages. Stream only gives a cleaner, more consistent layout; Full embed includes the provider room/chat experience when supported.
admin.configuration.crakrevenue_postback: Enable at least one CrakRevenue source in Public catalog to display its postback endpoint.
admin.catalog_settings.languages_intro: Choose the public language and the fallback used when a translation is unavailable.
admin.catalog_settings.primary_hint_comb: Used only as the fallback for legacy profile URLs while Combined providers is active.
admin.conversions.testing_tools_intro: Postback simulators use the same validation and storage path as public endpoints. Open this section only when validating an integration.
admin.appearance.reset_confirm: Restore the default theme and remove custom branding and localized homepage content?
admin.landings.reset_confirm: Restore the standard preset for this landing? Custom content for this landing will be replaced.
admin.i18n.fallback_notice: Empty fields use the {language} fallback when available.
admin.db_performance.title: Database performance
admin.db_performance.intro: Recommended database settings for large multi-provider catalogs. These are advisory and do not block LiveCamForge.
admin.conversions.sync_history_intro: Recent reporting-API polling runs. A successful run with zero received conversions is a valid result.
admin.conversions.sync_history_empty: No conversion polling runs have been recorded yet.

webmaster_recruitment.intro: Explore resources for building and monetizing a live cam affiliate site.
webmaster_recruitment.disclaimer: Affiliate programs, approval requirements and commission models are managed by their respective providers and may change over time.
admin.landings.heading: Page heading (H1)
admin.configuration.webmaster_recruitmen: Allow search engines to index the webmaster resources page
Optional HTTPS destination. For a LiveCamForge runtime you can point this to your own project or webmaster resource page.
admin.landings.provider_section_hint: These cards are shown immediately below the page introduction. Keep provider-specific information here.
admin.landings.general_body: General / SEO content below the provider cards
admin.landings.recruitment_body_hint: Provider-neutral editorial content shown below the recruitment cards. Use it for guides, platform-selection advice and SEO copy that applies to the page as a whole.
admin.landings.webmaster_body_hint: Editorial content shown below the webmaster page header and CTA. Use it for project information, affiliate guidance and SEO copy that applies to the page as a whole.
admin.landings.webmaster_cta_editor_hint: Configure the webmaster button here: destination URL and localized label are kept together. The public CTA is shown only when the URL is a valid HTTPS address.
webmaster_recruitment.preview_cta_missin: Preview only — configure the CTA URL in admin to make this button active.
webmaster_recruitment.cta_description: Continue with project documentation, setup guidance and the supported provider resources collected for webmasters.
recruitment.providers_intro: Compare the performer programs available on this site. Each registration is completed directly on the provider website.
admin.configuration.base_url_hint: Used for canonical URLs, sitemap and other absolute public URLs. Update this value after moving LiveCamForge to another domain or subdirectory.
admin.cron.title: Scheduled tasks not confirmed
admin.cron.intro: LiveCamForge cannot verify the cron jobs configured in your hosting control panel. Create the required scheduled tasks and confirm them here.
admin.cron.performer_frequency: Recommended starting point: every 10 minutes. Adjust the interval to your measured full-sync duration.
admin.cron.conversion_frequency: For CAM4 TUNE conversion polling: once per day is normally sufficient. This task is only needed when conversion polling is configured.
admin.cron.adapt_hint: These commands are templates from the deployment guide. Replace /usr/bin/php with the PHP CLI executable required by your host and adapt the absolute installation path.
admin.cron.confirm_label: I have configured the required scheduled tasks in my hosting control panel.
admin.cron.disclaimer: This confirmation records an administrator acknowledgement; LiveCamForge does not claim to have verified the hosting scheduler.
admin.cron.confirm_required: Tick the confirmation checkbox before confirming the scheduled tasks.
admin.cron.confirmed_notice: Scheduled-task setup confirmed by the administrator.
installer.demo_mode_hint: Uses two local demo providers with 40 fictional profiles each, blocks real integrations and marks public pages noindex.
admin.demo.title: Demo mode is active
admin.demo.intro: This installation uses fictional local providers. Real provider credentials, postback tests and recruitment integrations are blocked server-side.
admin.demo.blocked: This operation is disabled while Demo mode is active.
admin.demo.reset_confirm: Reset the demo catalog and editable demo presentation settings?
installer.demo_mode_providers_hint: Demo Alpha and Demo Beta are configured automatically. Initial provider choices are disabled while public Demo mode is selected.
admin.demo.provider_local_hint: Local fictional provider used only by public Demo mode. No API or affiliate credentials are required.
admin.demo.fixed_model_cta: Public Demo CTA is fixed to https://livecamforge.com/become-a-model/.
admin.demo.real_recruitment_locked: Real provider recruitment is disabled in Public Demo mode.
admin.demo.fixed_webmaster_cta: Public Demo CTA is fixed to https://livecamforge.com/for-webmasters/.
admin.demo.catalog_sources_locked: Provider sources are locked in Public Demo mode. Demo Alpha and Demo Beta are the only catalog sources.
